'''Volik''' was a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with rocky terrain that was located within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions']] [[Volik system/Legends|Volik system]]. The planet's surface was dominated by expansive [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] and small [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges, as well as numerous canyons and [[Water/Legends|waterfalls]]. Volik's [[Plant/Legends|plant]] life included the [[Bannak tree|bannak]] and [[tanna tree]]s and the [[mumau root]], while the [[reyko]] was the most frequently encountered example of the planet's fauna.

Four [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the company [[Vekanda Leisure Colonies]] began the construction of a [[The Colony (resort)|resort colony]] for wealthy clients on Volik, although the business soon folded, and the planet was abandoned. Shortly after that, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] established many bases of operations on the Unknown Regions world, both in the abandoned resort and in the canyons, and Volik continued to serve as home to various criminal groups over the following [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].

The [[Dynamic-class freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Nashuaga]]'' eventually crash-landed on Volik with the [[Mask of Darth Nihilus|mask]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] aboard. Sometime after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], several parties, including the [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] [[Apex Society]] and the smuggler group [[Sando's Boys]], attempted to find the mask of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nihilus, which was ultimately discovered in the remains of the ''Nashuaga'' by a third group of individuals.

After the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]] organized a community of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] on Volik, but Se'ol was eventually located by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], who led an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assault on Volik|assault]] on the planet. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, Volik was home to another group of Force-sensitives who had discovered the teachings of Se'ol.

==Description==
===Geography===
Volik was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located within the [[Volik system/Legends|Volik system]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. A [[Standard day/Legends|day]] on Volik was twenty-six [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]] long, and 410 [[Local day/Legends|local days]] made up the planet's [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Volik had two [[Moon/Legends|moons]], one of which loomed large in the planet's sky. The planet had standard [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], which was comfortable for the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and in which strong winds, low clouds, and vapor were all observed to form.<ref name="TUR" />

Volik's surface was divided into continents and had at least one [[Ocean/Legends|sea]]. The planet's terrain was predominantly rocky, with the main continent being covered in boulder-strewn [[Grass/Legends|grasslands]] that were separated by small [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges. There were many rocky canyon systems on Volik, created by the [[Water/Legends|runoff]] from the mountains and connected to the sea.<ref name="TUR" /> [[Cave/Legends|Cave]]-ins and other natural phenomena periodically affected the canyons enough to make [[Map/Legends|maps]] inaccurate.<ref name="Mask" /> The planet also had numerous impressive waterfalls that were the result of rivers emptying into the sea from the tops of tall bluffs. These waterfalls served as entrances to caverns located underneath the bluffs.<ref name="TUR" />

Volik had a [[Temperature/Legends|temperate]] climate with four seasons, including a moderate rainy season. It was never cold enough on the planet for snow to form, but the deeper canyons and the mountaintops froze over during the colder seasons. Floods occurred in the canyons, and flash floods could turn parts of once-dry plains into quick-flowing rivers in [[Standard second|seconds]].<ref name="TUR" />

===Flora and fauna===
The flora on Volik included the large [[bannak tree]]s, which grew in the foothills of the mountain ranges and were used for [[Tree/Legends|timber]]; [[tanna tree]]s, which bore large, purple, edible [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that were a staple in the [[Diet/Legends|diet]] of Volik's inhabitants; and a light-blue grass that grew on the plains and could reach a height of one [[Meter/Legends|meter]]. The [[mumau root]] could also be found in the mountains at high altitudes, especially in small pockets along the side of [[Mount Vorena]], the planet's highest peak. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dorin Se'ol]], a one-[[Time/Legends|time]] inhabitant of Volik, claimed that [[Tea/Legends|tea]] brewed from the mumau root helped [[Meditation/Legends|meditation]].<ref name="TUR" />

Wildlife on the planet included predators that stalked their prey on the plains<ref name="TUR" /> and in the mountains<ref name="Mask" /> using speed and ambush tactics, and [[Bird/Legends|birds]] and other aerial creatures that made their nests in trees near the mountains. The most common creature on Volik was the slow and docile, yet large and powerful herd animal [[reyko]], which was similar to the [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]]. The reyko fed on grass and had a hard and [[Chitin/Legends|chitinous]] skin that camouflaged the animal as a boulder to avoid predators. The [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] that operated from Volik often used reykos as beasts of burden. The reyko's skin was also impervious to [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]], so the criminals occasionally used the herbivores to ram the vehicles of rival gangs.<ref name="TUR" />

==History==
===Early colonization===
Volik was first discovered by a survey team of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Mining Corporation]]<ref name="TUR" /> at some point before the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nihilus]] [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Colony date">{{WizCite|book=The Unknown Regions|story=The Mask of Darth Nihilus}} states that [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] were already operating on Volik during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Darth Nihilus]], which indicates that the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was discovered by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Mining Corporation]], then colonized by [[Vekanda Leisure Colonies]], and eventually abandoned to the criminals at some point before the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Nihilus.</ref> in the year [[3951 BBY]],<ref name="Nihilus date">The [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Darth Nihilus]] is depicted in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3951 BBY]].</ref> although no [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] resources of interest were found on the planet. The rights to colonize the Unknown Regions world were sold to the company [[Vekanda Leisure Colonies]], however, and the planet was settled at the height of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The company began the construction of a [[The Colony (resort)|resort colony]] for wealthy clients, where they could [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] the native fauna and dine on exotic [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]].<ref name="TUR" />

However, Vekanda ran into financial problems soon after the colony was established, and the colony and Volik were abandoned. After that, no other business attempted to purchase the rights to the colony to reestablish it. At some point in Volik's history, members of both the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] mystical traditions had small outposts on the planet, with numerous Jedi living on Volik over time. The extensive treasure of [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Czazizs]] was also rumored to be found somewhere on the Unknown Regions world.<ref name="TUR" />

{{RPGseed}}
An illegal [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop race]] once took place in the canyons of Volik. A group of individuals indebted to a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] entered the race in order to pay off their debt with the considerable prize [[Currency/Legends|money]]. The crime [[Lord/Legends|lord]], not wishing to let the group escape its debt, bribed some of the other [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to cause those individuals to lose the competition. During the race, one of the crime lord's hirelings scared a herd of local reykos onto the racing course, causing a dangerous situation.<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

Shortly after Vekanda Leisure Colonies abandoned Volik, multiple groups of pirates and smugglers began to operate from the planet, occasionally warring against each other for its control. These conflicts sometimes resulted in the gangs wiping each other out and leaving Volik uninhabited for [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] until new groups of criminals arrived on the planet.<ref name="TUR" />

Two pirate groups&mdash;the [[Crimson Stars]], led by the Human [[Vallkos]], and the [[Ebon Strikers]], led by Vallkos' brother, [[Mallikhan]]&mdash;settled on Volik around this time. The two pirate leaders had a fierce rivalry that was caused by a [[Unidentified female (Vallkos and Mallikhan)|female]] from the brother's past. Eventually, the conflict between the Crimson Stars and the Ebon Strikers came close to an explosive outbreak of violence.<ref name="TUR" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of individuals sought out the [[Gender/Legends|female]] for her to help them [[Diplomat/Legends|mediate]] the situation on Volik during that time.<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

===The mask of Darth Nihilus===
[[File:Nihilus_mask.jpg|thumb|right|150px|The mask of Darth Nihilus, located on Volik for millennia]]
During the reign of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nihilus, the most prominent smuggler gang on Volik was the [[Wavelength Gale]].<ref name="Mask" /> After Nihilus' death,<ref name="Nashuaga date">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'' depicts [[Darth Nihilus]] wearing his [[Mask of Darth Nihilus|mask]] for some [[Time/Legends|time]] up until his [[Death/Legends|death]], while {{WizCite|book=The Unknown Regions|story=The Mask of Darth Nihilus}} depicts the discovery of the artifact in the remains of the ''[[Nashuaga]]'' on Volik [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] later. Combining these two facts leads to the conclusion that the ''Nashuaga'' crash-landed on Volik with the mask of [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Nihilus aboard at some point after the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord's]] death.</ref> the [[Dynamic-class freighter/Legends|''Dynamic''-class freighter]] ''[[Nashuaga]]'', with the [[mask of Darth Nihilus]] contained within the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Captain/Legends|captain's]] secret onboard stash, crash-landed in a [[Wavelength Gale's hidden cove|hidden cove]] on Volik, where the Wavelength Gale's base was located.<ref name="Mask" />

[[Sando (smuggler)|Sando]], a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] smuggler and pirate who operated in the Unknown Regions near Volik, was leading a small group of criminals, known as [[Sando's Boys]], in looting abandoned smuggler bases in Volik's caverns following the death of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]<ref name="Mask" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> On one of her looting expeditions, Sando discovered the cargo manifest of an old freighter, which contained information on the long-lost mask of Darth Nihilus. The Rodian decided to find the artifact and sell it to the highest bidder.<ref name="Mask" />

{{RPGseed}}
Another group of individuals arrived on Volik around the same time in an attempt of their own to find Darth Nihilus' mask. The group climbed Mount Vorena and reactivated the [[Portable beacon|landing beacon]] planted there by the Wavelength Gale [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] earlier. The individuals then used the beacon to pinpoint the location of the Wavelength Gale's abandoned base. However, while still on the top of Mount Vorena, the group was attacked by [[Collan Eislo]], a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] and the leader of the [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] [[Apex Society]], along with his Society allies. Eislo had also tracked Darth Nihilus' mask to Volik in order to acquire it for his own purposes, and he attempted to learn the mask's location from the group.<ref name="Mask" />

Eislo's rivals in the search for the mask of Darth Nihilus dealt with the young noble and traveled to the Wavelength Gale's hidden cove, only to encounter upon arrival Sando's Boys, who were already looking for the mask in the wreck of the ''Nashuaga''. When the criminals noticed the new arrivals, Sando's Boys attacked them but were eventually defeated, and the victors of the fight subsequently discovered Darth Nihilus' mask in the remains of the ''Nashuaga''.<ref name="Mask" />
{{Endgame}}

===The arrival of Dorin Se'ol===
Not long after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] ended<ref name="TUR" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> the Jedi Master Dorin Se'ol arrived on Volik and began to rebuild the colony. Se'ol [[Marriage/Legends|married]] a woman named [[Vorena]], with whom he had a daughter named [[Jolee]], and also organized and taught a community of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] beings on Volik, which managed to chase the smugglers off the planet. Vorena's eventual death caused Se'ol to have a brief struggle with the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. The Jedi Master climbed to the top of Mount Vorena after his wife died to meditate.<ref name="TUR" />

{{RPGseed}}
A group of [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi apprentices]] were sent to Volik as part of their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] at some point in the planet's history. The trainees were instructed to climb Mount Vorena in seven days' time, packing nothing but their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. After a difficult climb that included foraging and protecting themselves against the strong winds and local predators, the apprentices met their Jedi Master on the mountain's top, who then bestowed the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] to the group members.<ref name="TUR" />

During Dorin Se'ol's time living on Volik, a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] made a brief stop at the planet, and Se'ol's young daughter, Jolee, boarded the vessel without his knowledge. Se'ol consequently tasked a group of his students to retrieve his daughter, and the students eventually found the merchant vessel.<ref name="TUR" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:Darth_Vader_SWG_by_Darren_Tan.jpg|thumb|left|240px|Darth Vader led an Imperial assault on Volik.]]
Dorin Se'ol escaped the attention of the Sith Lord [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] for some time while living on Volik; however, Vader finally discovered the Jedi Master and led an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Assault on Volik|assault]] on the planet. During the attack, Se'ol distracted Vader long enough for a small group of his students to escape Volik before the Jedi Master perished.<ref name="TUR" />

When the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] species [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invaded]] the galaxy<ref name="TUR" /> between [[25 ABY/Legends|25]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]],<ref name="TEA" /> a small group of Force-sensitive pacifists discovered a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] containing Se'ol's teachings. These pacifists then learned of Volik's existence and settled on the planet, where they remained until the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|end]] of that conflict. During the [[Second Imperial Civil War]] a [[Standard century/Legends|century]] later, smugglers avoided Volik, considering the planet bad [[luck]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Inhabitants==
Although the Vekanda Leisure Colonies intended to turn Volik into a resort for wealthy visitors, the planet was abandoned and eventually settled by pirates and smugglers. The two most prominent pirate groups on Volik at some point were the Crimson Stars and the Ebon Strikers, led by the Human brothers Vallkos and Mallikhan, respectively. Sometimes, the Ebon Strikers raided Crimson Star ships returning from resupply and trading runs in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]], causing short skirmishes in the [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Volik. The Unknown Regions world was also home to two groups of Force-sensitive individuals, one during the reign of the Galactic Empire and the other during the Yuuzhan Vong invasion.<ref name="TUR" />

Ninety-five percent of Volik's sentient population was Human, while other species made up the rest, although the planet was sometimes left completely uninhabited, sometimes for decades. Such instances occurred after the most brutal conflicts between the pirates and smugglers, then again between the time of the Galactic Empire's assault on the planet and the Yuuzhan Vong invasion, and once again during the Second Imperial Civil War. Anarchy reigned on Volik; however, the original resort, the Colony, was considered the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Volik had no major exports to offer; foodstuffs and luxury goods had to be imported on the planet.<ref name="TUR" />

The original resort offered [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-equipped [[wind skiff]]s built from bannak tree wood for visitors to sail across the expansive grasslands of Volik. Over the years since Vekanda Leisure Colonies abandoned the planet, smuggling gangs claimed these vehicles and stripped them for parts or damaged them in raids. However, some gangs redesigned the wind skiffs as wind-driven [[wheel]]ed vehicles.<ref name="TUR" />

==Locations==
Many rocky canyons on Volik were interesting to swoop racers as natural and challenging race routes. When pirates started to operate from the planet, they found the canyons ideally suited for storing their [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], pillaged goods, weapons, and contraband; however, occasional rainy weather caused flash floods that washed the criminals' loot out to the sea. The mountains on the planet also featured numerous waterfalls, which the local smugglers used to evade pursuit, with good piloting skills required to fly underneath them. [[Akriva Falls]] was named after [[Akriva]], a notorious [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] pirate who would fly underneath the falls' arcs to avoid pursuers.<ref name="TUR" />

===Mount Vorena===
The highest mountain on Volik was Mount Vorena, named after the deceased wife of Jedi Master Dorin Se'ol. A river originating in the melting ice caps atop Mount Vorena cascaded down the mountain's rocky face and ended in the [[Jolee Falls]], an impressive waterfall named after Se'ol and Vorena's only daughter.<ref name="TUR" /> Landing a vehicle on the peak of Mount Verona was almost impossible because of strong winds, and climbing Mount Vorena was difficult and made dangerous by rockslides and predators;<ref name="Mask" /> however, the view from the top was considered spectacular.<ref name="TUR" />

The smuggler band Wavelength Gale installed a small [[Transmitter/Legends|transmitter]] beacon atop Mount Vorena, which remained there for millennia.<ref name="Mask" /> After Se'ol ascended to the top of Mount Vorena, the mountain became a destination for Jedi, who climbed it to contact the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force spirits]] of their teachers and comrades. By the time of the Second Imperial Civil War, Mount Vorena was avoided by pilots regardless of their belief in superstition, and several Force-sensitive individuals sensed a strange presence surrounding the mountain, one of the possible explanations being that a Jedi that had once lived on Volik had returned there in spirit form.<ref name="TUR" />

===Wavelength Gale's hidden cove===
[[File:Nashuaga.png|thumb|right|180px|The cavern on Volik where the wrecked ''Nashuaga'' rested]]
The Wavelength Gale smuggler band leader chose a large, half-submerged cove on Volik for the group's base. The cove was in a large, open strip of a cavern with walls on opposing sides. It looked like an avalanche formed it and could only be reached by traveling on [[Limb/Legends|foot]] through narrow, winding caverns that started near the base of Mount Vorena. The pirates found the cove easy to defend since it could not be accessed by air, and the tunnels that served as its entrance were dark and dangerous. At some point, the ''Nashuaga'', a ''Dynamic''-class freighter, crash-landed in the cove and came to rest half-buried in mud and rock and half-sunken in the waters of the cove.<ref name="Mask" />

Eventually, the Wavelength Gale abandoned its base, which was left with hundreds of scattered crates. Millennia later, the criminal group Sando's Boys attempted to find Darth Nihilus' mask on the wreck of the ''Nashuaga''. To this end, the criminals dug a tunnel through rock that allowed access to the ship and set up a perimeter of [[Glowrod/Legends|glow lamps]] to illuminate the area.<ref name="Mask" />

===The Colony===
After purchasing the rights to colonize Volik, Vekanda Leisure Colonies began constructing the Colony, a luxurious resort located in the shadow of Mount Vorena. The resort had a central concourse, and buildings made out of bannak tree wood, including the main building with small dorms on the lower floors and large penthouses near the roof. A large [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] sculpture intended to welcome visitors to the resort was installed as a centerpiece of a massive fountain. Other colony buildings were located in different parts of the planet, including a few cabins near Mount Vorena that were meant for visitors interested in climbing.<ref name="TUR" />

When Vekanda abandoned the planet, all the construction on the resort was left unfinished, with the planned [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] yet to be completed and several of its [[Hangar/Legends|landing bays]] still just sandpits surrounded by construction materials. The central concourse was left stripped of everything valuable.<ref name="TUR" />

When pirates and smugglers moved into the abandoned resort, they repurposed the buildings yet left them standing, and they offered their new inhabitants a level of comfort not provided by typical pirate bases, such as [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid fields]].<ref name="TUR" />

The criminals used the main building at various points as a warehouse and a [[Prison/Legends|prison]], among other uses, although it was most often occupied by the smuggler gang that was the most successful on Volik at the time. However, since many gangs broke up due to infighting after moving into the building, some smuggler groups refused to take up residence there even when given the opportunity. The penthouses of the main building were usually reserved for the leaders of the smuggler gangs but sometimes were just set up to look that way to mislead their enemies.<ref name="TUR" />

The smugglers left most of the other colony buildings vacant since Volik's canyons were easier to defend and therefore better for setting up camp. Jedi Master Dorin Se'ol used a few of the cabins near Mount Vorena for his own use and that of his students, and it was later rumored that such Jedi artifacts as lightsabers and holocrons were hidden in the vicinity of these buildings.<ref name="TUR" />

The location of the old resort's crystal sculpture served the pirates and smugglers as a neutral site for negotiations. When the sculpture was [[Thief/Legends|stolen]] on occasion, the criminals temporarily ceased any hostilities to retrieve the sculpture and punish those who had stolen it.<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Volik was introduced in ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', a sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was developed by [[Wizards of the Coast]]. ''The Unknown Regions'' was written by [[Sterling Hershey]], [[Rodney Thompson]], and [[Daniel Wallace]], and was published in [[2010]]. Within that book, Volik was mentioned in several adventure seeds for use with the ''Star Wars Roleplaying Game'',<ref name="TUR" /> as well as the mini-adventure "[[The Mask of Darth Nihilus]]." This article assumes all of those scenarios play out as described.<ref name="Mask" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Volik [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet, in grid square H-7.<ref name="TEAOC" />
